items.text: Can you check off all 9 squares? Save this bingo card and see how many you can complete at your #RBRadiance Pre-Rifts!
Pre-Rift is finally here! Our creators got a few rounds in at the LA Summit Pre-Rift. Here's what they had to say after their first taste of the set! #RBRadiance

We're coming up on one year of Riftbound, and always finding ways to level up the game! We're exploring three potential changes to turn order to help create a more balanced playing experience. These changes will be tested at events worldwide, outside of premier tournaments. Article: https://riot.com/3UvUU3M
Got the right card in hand? Show it off to your opponent as you play a card to unlock an additional effect! #RBRadiance

Looking to amp up your deck? Check out the new #RBRadiance Alt Art Runes you can find in booster packs! Get your first hands-on experience with Radiance at Pre-Rift events starting October 16! Find an event near you at PlayRiftbound.com
Take your Gear straight to the battlefield with Deploy to gain an effect, but watch out! Your opponent might be waiting to respond. #RBRadiance

Get your first hands-on experience with #RBRadiance at Pre-Rift events, starting October 16! Check out the event locator at PlayRiftbound.com today to find your nearest store.
